title: RDS instance without storage encryption
description: RDS storage should be encrypted at rest. The provider default for storage_encrypted is false, so an absent attribute is a finding.

title: RDS instance without deletion protection
description: Deletion protection guards against accidental database destruction. The provider default is false.

title: RDS instance publicly accessible
description: A publicly accessible database accepts connections from the internet. Keep databases in private subnets with publicly_accessible false (the provider default).

title: RDS instance without backup retention
description: With backup_retention_period absent or 0, automated backups are disabled and point-in-time recovery is impossible after data loss.

title: RDS without IAM database authentication
description: With iam_database_authentication_enabled absent or false, database access relies on long-lived passwords instead of short-lived IAM credentials, weakening credential hygiene. Engine-scoped: only mysql, postgres and mariadb instances support IAM database authentication; aurora engines are covered by the cluster rules.

title: RDS without IAM database authentication
description: With iam_database_authentication_enabled absent or false, database access relies on long-lived passwords instead of short-lived IAM credentials, weakening credential hygiene. Engine-scoped: only mysql, postgres and mariadb instances support IAM database authentication; aurora engines are covered by the cluster rules.

title: Hardcoded credentials in resource config
description: A database password written as a literal in Terraform config is stored in state, plan output, and version control. The same holds for a secret-like variable or local flowing into a credential attribute. Reference a secrets manager or a generated password instead. The secret value is never included in findings.

evidence.expected: reference to a secrets manager or generated password

title: RDS instance without Multi-AZ
description: Single-AZ RDS instances have no standby for failover. Enable multi_az for production databases.

title: RDS instance without Multi-AZ
description: Single-AZ RDS instances have no standby for failover. Enable multi_az for production databases.

title: RDS instance without CloudWatch log exports
description: Hygiene: RDS instances should export database logs to CloudWatch via enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports for auditing and troubleshooting. Without log exports, forensic analysis after an incident is limited.

title: RDS instance without CloudWatch log exports
description: Hygiene: RDS instances should export database logs to CloudWatch via enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports for auditing and troubleshooting. Without log exports, forensic analysis after an incident is limited.

title: RDS instance without copy_tags_to_snapshot
description: Hygiene: RDS instances should copy tags to snapshots so backup resources inherit cost-allocation and ownership tags. Set copy_tags_to_snapshot = true.

title: RDS instance without copy_tags_to_snapshot
description: Hygiene: RDS instances should copy tags to snapshots so backup resources inherit cost-allocation and ownership tags. Set copy_tags_to_snapshot = true.

title: RDS instance without enhanced monitoring
description: Hygiene: RDS instances should enable enhanced monitoring (monitoring_interval > 0) for OS-level metrics that aid troubleshooting. Set monitoring_interval to 1, 5, 10, 15, 30 or 60.

title: RDS instance without enhanced monitoring
description: Hygiene: RDS instances should enable enhanced monitoring (monitoring_interval > 0) for OS-level metrics that aid troubleshooting. Set monitoring_interval to 1, 5, 10, 15, 30 or 60.

title: RDS Postgres instance without query logging
description: Hygiene: RDS Postgres instances should export postgresql logs to CloudWatch for query auditing. Add "postgresql" to enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports.

title: RDS instance without Performance Insights
description: Hygiene: RDS instances should enable Performance Insights for query-level performance analysis. Set performance_insights_enabled = true.

title: RDS instance without Performance Insights
description: Hygiene: RDS instances should enable Performance Insights for query-level performance analysis. Set performance_insights_enabled = true.

title: RDS instance on the default option group
description: option_group_name is absent or a default group, so the instance runs with AWS's generic options (e.g. no OEM, no MariaDB audit plugin). Use a purpose-built option group.

title: RDS instance on the default option group
description: option_group_name is absent or a default group, so the instance runs with AWS's generic options (e.g. no OEM, no MariaDB audit plugin). Use a purpose-built option group.

title: RDS master password not managed by Secrets Manager
description: A plaintext master password is set without manage_master_user_password, so the credential sits in state and is never rotated automatically. Use manage_master_user_password = true so RDS manages rotation in Secrets Manager. The password value is never included in findings.
